title: aegialina tenuis
intro: Aegialina tenuis, commonly known as Sea Lavender, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It is native to the Mediterranean region and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Aegialina tenuis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, diterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as its sedative and antispasmodic effects, and its ability to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage.
